basis: The statutes (articles 1, 11 and the Patronato articles) give the form, the parent ministry, the director's appointment and the budget approval, the Tribunal de Cuentas report (paragraphs 1.7, 1.26, 2.53, 2.79) gives the audit, procurement, transparency and labour-law status, and the transparency page lists the applicable laws.

governance.parent: Consejería de Cultura, Turismo y Deporte de la Comunidad de Madrid

basis: The museum's own El Museo page calls it the contemporary art museum of the Comunidad de Madrid with a team of Consejería employees, and its transparency page applies Ley 10/2019 to the museum.

The organisation page names the foundation, its public founding members and its Board of Trustees, the 2019 announcement shows the board appointing the director, and the December 2025 announcement shows the board approving the 2026 budget.

The Basque public sector register entry (2024, pages 1 to 2) lists Centro Internacional de Cultura Contemporánea, S.A. as a mercantile company without profit motive owned one third each by the Basque government, the San Sebastián council and the Gipuzkoa provincial council.
The foundation's who-we-are page says Marcelino Botín and his wife created it in 1964 and calls the Botin Centre its most important project, and its organisation page lists the Board of Trustees.

governance.parent: conselleria with competence for culture, Generalitat Valenciana

basis: Ley 1/2018 of the Generalitat, articles 1 (form and parent), 11 (director named by decree of the Consell), 16 (procurement) and 17 (staff and civil service rules), is the statute that governs the institute.

The Basque foundations register entry and the statutes revised in 2019 (articles 6, 17, 18 and 31) give the foundation, its public trustees, the board's power to name executive posts and the Protectorado, and the 2002 certified statutes state that the Diputación Foral de Álava created it.

The Governance section of the museum's about page says a Board of Directors elected by the Museum Committee governs it, states its not-for-profit objectives and prints its company and NGO Secretariat registration numbers.
The konsthall's own site footer reads "en del av Lunds kommun".
